titulo: Guess: Coca-Cola 2020 dividends, per buyout offer?
caption:
Guess: Coca-Cola 2020 dividends, per buyout offer?

A, B or C? Comment your guess before the answer.

From Aug 2020 and Feb 2021 filings. Coca-Cola Form 10-K for 2020, filed Feb 25, 2021: Dividends, 2020: $7,047,000,000. Coca-Cola press release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1), filed Aug 28, 2020: Employees first offered voluntary separation: about 4,000.

The dividends are company-wide, for all of 2020. The 4,000 is the number of employees first offered a voluntary separation package (the press release says "approximately 4,000 employees in the United States, Canada and Puerto Rico"); it is not a layoff count.

The count: $7,047,000,000 ÷ about 4,000 = about $1,761,750, rounded down.

No voiceover. Sources below.

Sources

F1: Coca-Cola press release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1), filed Aug 28, 2020 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000155278120000463/e20478_ex99-1.htm
